note: Paths are specs resolved by _task5_helpers.resolve. Inputs marked assumed=true are not held yet. Change freely.

reliance.derivative_fn_note: module:function taking (dem ndarray, res float) and returning (C,H,W) float32 in the exact channel order the pit model reads. Empty uses the in-script FALLBACK (slope, tpi, local relief, roughness, hillshade), which is NOT the trained stack and is labelled fallback in every output.
reliance.scorer_fn_note: module:function taking (stack ndarray (C,H,W), fold int, checkpoint Path) and returning a (H,W) probability. Needs the P1 isolated pit checkpoint.
reliance.sham_note: Sham offsets keep the shifted mask inside the 128 m scene, within the pit model's receptive field. A sham outside it would be trivially null.

stage2.delta_gain_note: User decision. Recall-at-K gain in recall units that justifies deployment (from downstream value and cost). null means the decision is reported as 'no margin set'.

trainers.note: The pit isolated trainer is P1 S3 (not built). The road trainer is a copy of _road_unet_1m_recall.py that reads the shared folds (not built, GPU). Each must accept --split-file and --fold.

pit_blocks.hint: 375 m pit block grid, layer 'blocks', columns block_id, ix, iy, n_pits

pad_blocks.hint: 375 m pad block grid, layer 'blocks', columns block_id, n_pads

pit_assign.hint: historical pit fold assignment (pit_inside_id, block_id, fold)

pad_assign.hint: historical pad fold assignment (pad_id, block_id, fold)

features.hint: frozen 0.5 m pit stack, band 3 = slope

pit_oof.hint: uint8 OOF pit mosaic, prob = DN/254, 255 nodata. Historical pit scheme

pad_fold_prob.hint: per-fold pad probability rasters, historical pad scheme

audit_blocks.schema: csv with column block_id (int). From P2 S2
audit_blocks.hint: P2 audit set. Run P2 first or pass --allow-no-audit for a provisional fold file

shared_training_log.schema: json {train: [block_id], val: [block_id], held_out: [block_id]} written by the shared-scheme trainer
shared_training_log.hint: S3 retraining. The S6 audit reads it

road_prob_insample.hint: in-sample 1 m road probability. Provisional runs only. Not out-of-fold

isolated_pit_ckpt.schema: P1 isolated pit U-Net checkpoint per fold
isolated_pit_ckpt.hint: P1 S3 isolated pit trainer (not built). Needed by S2 rescoring

shared_pit_oof.schema: pit OOF mosaic on the shared scheme, same grid as features_pit_9t_05.tif, float32 or uint8 DN/254
shared_pit_oof.hint: S3 retraining on the shared scheme (GPU, not run). Use --mode provisional for the pipeline test

isolated_pit_folds.schema: json with block_to_fold {block_id: fold} for the P1 isolated pit models
isolated_pit_folds.hint: P1 S2 immutable split file. Each unit is scored by the isolated model that held out its block

stacking_mode_note: nested (default). Outer fold k test candidates use upstream model k. Training candidates in fold j use model (k, j), which excluded k and j, so training features are out-of-fold too. outer. Every candidate in outer fold k uses model k (meets the fw_5_1 definition, but training features are in-sample). provisional. Historical rasters (pit OOF mosaic, pad per-fold on the pad scheme, in-sample road). The S6 audit fails it by design.

upstream_rasters.note: Patterns. {k} outer fold, {j} inner fold. Roles pit (stage-1 score and candidates), pad, road. Nested and outer rasters are ASSUMED (S3 retraining, GPU).
